reddit-mcp-buddy.how: Set REDDIT_BUDDY_HTTP=true and REDDIT_BUDDY_PORT=<port>. Endpoint http://127.0.0.1:<port>/mcp.
reddit-mcp-buddy.auth: Reads public Reddit only. Rejects a forged Host header with 403.

slack-mcp-server.how: Run with --transport http and SLACK_MCP_HOST=127.0.0.1, SLACK_MCP_PORT=<port>. Endpoint /mcp.
slack-mcp-server.auth: Set SLACK_MCP_API_KEY and have each agent send it as a Bearer header. The key guards tool calls only: tools/list answers without it, and with no key set every call is accepted.

mcp-atlassian.auth: Over HTTP it ignores its own stored token and answers 401 unless a request carries credentials. Have each agent send Authorization: Basic base64(email:token). Do not set ALLOW_GLOBAL_CRED_FALLBACK, which lets any local caller act as you.

awslabs.aws-pricing-mcp-server.how: Starts with mcp.run() and no transport option, so it speaks stdio only.

@upstash/context7-mcp.how: Point every agent at the hosted URL and drop the local copy. An API key is optional, for higher rate limits.

@playwright/mcp.auth: One shared server means one shared browser, so tabs and logins mix across sessions. Keep it per session unless that is what you want.
